resolution: The rerender split was conclusive: shell 137-162 + loaderPane 0 — the loader pane's own render is free; the entire pre is the sibling panels rendering before it. On /editor those are PropertiesPanel and RightPanel (the paint tools). Found the bulk: RightPanel fed FacePainter pieces={buildPieces} — a fresh array identity every place — so the memoized skin grid (a grid of texture Effects) re-rendered on every placement even though it only paints the SELECTED pieces. First real CUT (not instrumentation): compute a STABLE reference to the selected pieces in EditorShell (paintTargetPieces filtered + a content sig so a memo holds the ref steady while the selected pieces are unchanged) and pass that as paintPieces; also stabilized onOpenPainter (was an inline arrow that alone defeated FacePainter's memo) via useCallback. Verified safe: FacePainter uses props.pieces ONLY to derive selPieces = pieces.filter(selectedIds) (line 150-152), so selected-only input is behaviorally identical; painting/moving a selected piece still refreshes (sig changes), an unrelated place skips. Bundle clean, cart-side hot-reload. Sha ac86eb516. Expect the shell number to drop by FacePainter's share; if PropertiesPanel (still unmemoized) is the remainder, that's the next cut.
